title: loop-review payload contract
description: The two payload shapes /loop-review asks its passes for. Peer of finding.schema.json, not derived from it at run time. The prompt templates in prompts/loop-review/ are GENERATED from the two entrypoints; edit this file, never those blocks.

x-projection.note: loopFinding is a projection of the consensus finding. Every difference must be listed here; the check in scripts/gen-contracts.mjs fails on any other.

x-runtime.note: This schema states the contract the prompts ask for. The runtime validators deliberately disagree with it in the ways listed below, and test/unit/conformance.test.mjs asserts that this is EXACTLY the set that disagrees. Not encoded as JSON Schema keywords on purpose: doing so would need minLength/pattern/if-then and would grow the local validator for rules a direct assertion covers better.

tolerates.note: runtime accepts MORE than the schema

numeric-nullable-fields.detail: a number is accepted where the schema says string|null. The prompt is never told this — it asks for the narrow contract. For failure_scenario the tolerance is reachable only at P2: at P0/P1 the actionable bar below demands a non-blank string, so a number is rejected there for that reason instead.

extra-finding-properties.detail: unknown properties are ignored, while the schema sets additionalProperties: false

uncovered-cell-omissions.detail: required only when status is "covered"; the schema requires them unconditionally, as the prompt asks

absent-verifier-arrays.detail: an absent array is legal and defaults to []; only a present-but-not-array value is a malformed envelope

requires.note: runtime accepts LESS than the schema — the evidence bar, enforced in code

non-blank-strings.detail: must be non-blank after trimming; the schema admits "" and "   "

actionable-needs-scenario.detail: must be a non-blank string when severity is P0 or P1; the schema admits null at every severity

covered-cell-substance.detail: a covered cell needs at least one anchor and one check, all non-blank, a non-blank context_used, and at least one anchor that validAnchor accepts for the cell's own files and line bounds
